basis.targetNote: The original target was approximately 120px; the correction request asked generation for 140–150px corridors to leave visual margin above the 96px footprint requirement.
basis.uncertainty: ±10 px. Ranges are approximate visual evidence between painted obstacle/foliage edges, not pixel-exact certified minima, image segmentation, or future placement coordinates.

scope.evaluated: Open painted corridor width at three representative heights in each of six vertical lanes, selected bottom bends, bridge end joins, shelters, meadow spurs, and barrier density.
scope.excluded: No 53-anchor mapping, no old V5 coordinates, no token placement certification, and no bridge-deck width check; bridges are connectors only.

meadowSpurs.barrierAssessment: All three are visually dense and distinct, and now read as a near-continuous central spine through overlapping or near-contiguous foliage. Both side corridors retain conservative 96px-plus clearance; no broad cross-through is visible.

denseBarriers: Wetland reed and pond edges remain the narrowest wetland visual edges but retain >=100px at conservative estimate.
Meadow shelter foliage forms a continuous central barrier while preserving both side corridors.
The compacted lower grotto preserves the required right-side route; its left-side chasm-to-grotto clearance is visually about 115–135px and its right-side frame clearance about 110–130px.

result.reason: All selected-candidate transects, bottom bends, and bridge end joins have conservative lower estimates >=96px. The smallest sampled lower estimate is 100px at the wetland inner-right middle cross-section; the corrected lower-grotto left/right clearances are about 115–135px and 110–130px respectively.
openIssues: This is approximate manual visual evidence with ±10px uncertainty, not pixel-exact certified minima, deterministic segmentation, or a 53-anchor placement certification.
The broad clearing below the upper oasis is token-capable; the narrow decorative water-side strip above it remains intentionally excluded from the route.
The target was ~120px, so the wetland inner-right middle sample has only a small visual margin above the 96px footprint threshold.
